title: Choose an account-scoped sender stream key
objective: Repair sender_stream_key so historical messages can be grouped by the strongest exact sender-stream identity without crossing account boundaries. Prefer normalized List-ID, then normalized From address, then From domain as a last-resort fallback. Return null when no usable identity exists. Do not change the test.
acceptance_criteria: every non-null key includes the supplied account_id so identical public identities in different accounts remain separately scoped
normalized List-ID takes precedence over From address when present
normalized From address is used when List-ID is absent
From domain is used only as a fallback when exact List-ID and From address are unavailable
no identity produces null rather than an invented cluster key
the fixed acceptance test passes without modification
